title: Rabbah bar Kahana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah at the end of the Petichtot, and Hyman suggests that the reference there is to Rabbi Abba bar Kahana. In Nazir 42a, according to Tosafot’s reading there, Rabbah bar Rav Kahana; but in the Gemara it reads “Rabbah said that Rav Huna said,” and so the Gemara implies, since Rav Yosef afterward says “for Rav Huna said.”

notes.text: The consulted Davidson edition places the statement that Rabbah reports Rav Huna at the opening of the Gemara on Nazir 42b. Hyman cites 42a.
